text: Entry Requirements 1.High school diploma or equivalent qualification. 2. Non-Chinese citizens holding a valid ordinary foreign passport, in compliance with the relevant regulations of the Chinese Ministry of Education, including the “Document No.12 (2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC” and etc. 3. Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, have no criminal record, and satisfy the medical examination standards for international students in China. 4. Applicants must between 16 and 24 years old, inclusive. 5. Generally, applicants should hold an HSK Level 3 over 180 score or above, or equivalent. *Note: Applicants who have not yet met the language requirement but intend to pursue Pre-University studies may be considered on a case-by-case basis.
